name: StandX DUSD
oneLiner: DUSD is StandX's delta-neutral synthetic dollar, redeemable 1:1 against USDT/USDC and backed by hedged BTC/ETH/SOL positions on CEXes via Ceffu custody.
collateral: USDT/USDC deposits converted to hedged crypto positions (BTC, ETH, SOL) via Ceffu
pegMechanism: Delta-neutral hedging on centralized exchanges; 1:1 USDT/USDC redemption

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: StandX documents conversion of stablecoin deposits into spot digital assets paired with matching short perpetual positions, with the stability reserve and managed hedge system absorbing basis and liquidation stress. The peg therefore depends on a centrally operated delta-neutral portfolio, which directly matches synthetic-delta-neutral.

oracleRisk.summary: StandX documents multiple independent price feeds, median selection, deviation circuit breakers, secondary networks, TWAP fallbacks, and manual intervention for its managed collateral and hedging system.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: DUSD is minted from USDT or USDC into a managed vault and offchain hedging system, and redemption uses a seven-day unwind period. StandX monitors collateral, hedge positions, and liquidation triggers operationally, but users do not open permissionless per-collateral debt positions with independently inventoried onchain auction, backstop, and shutdown branches.

reserves.name: Market-neutral spot collateral, perpetual hedges, and stability reserve
reserves.issuerOrObligor: StandX protocol, custodians, and undisclosed centralized-exchange counterparties

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: StandX architecture, minting, risks/hedging, redemption, and product-FAQ pages still describe DUSD as market-neutral / delta-neutral — USDT/USDC mint inputs converted into spot crypto (examples include ETH, SOL, BTC) with matching short perpetual hedges plus a stability/RSV reserve fund for negative funding — without any dated balance sheet, component weights, venue inventory, or Stability Reserve Fund size. Product FAQ points users to the website for a 'reserve ratio' but the public dashboard and overview pages return no itemized composition, PoR, or attestation. Independently, DefiLlama classifies StandX DUSD as pegMechanism crypto-backed with mint/redeem via USDT/USDC and publishes circulating supply only (no reserve breakdown). No public API on api.standx.com, perps.standx.com, or ice.standx.com exposes reserve composition. Therefore the prior fabricated 50/45/5 split remains rejected; the narrowest source-supported row is the 100% aggregate market-neutral envelope with knownUnknownExposurePct 100.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: StandX architecture, minting, hedging, redemption, and product-FAQ documentation re-opened 2026-07-28; component weights remain undisclosed; DefiLlama corroborates crypto-backed peg without a reserve breakdown
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current reserve weights, exact spot constituents, exchange counterparties, custodian shares, and the Stability Reserve Fund composition are not disclosed in the reviewed primary sources or independent catalogs.

mintAuthority.summary: StandX DUSD uses an on-chain Gateway for USDT/USDC deposits. Solana mint authority is a PDA of an immutable program, and BSC's sole MINTER_ROLE is the Gateway controller proxy under a 3-of-4 DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe; the terminal Settler/RSV backend signer set is issuer-undisclosed and is the manual-review cap on this profile.

controls.label: StandX BSC Gateway (sole MINTER_ROLE)
controls.evidence: 2026-07-20: a full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked log scan of the BSC DUSD token from deployment (block 47,000,000) through block 111,600,000 confirms MINTER_ROLE was granted to this Gateway controller proxy at block 47,451,545 and revoked from the deployer in the same transaction — it is the only MINTER_ROLE holder that has ever existed. Docs describe Gateway contract minting on USDT/USDC collateral deposit with a 7-day redemption lock. 2026-07-20 follow-up (BSC block 111,123,001+, bsc-dataseed.binance.org): the Gateway 0x2c02f575cdd0cc87de89ae6a493b05a5ed95065a is a 130-byte ERC-1822/UUPS delegating proxy that loads its implementation from the non-ERC1967 slot 0x827d913d90d0c987a6f064bb327aef37980afaf247de25f9b07747de0af89dd1 (currently 0xdf09ebf9a24080deedb0a9a85db0b3aa9a90caa1); both ERC-1967 slots on the proxy read zero, and the implementation's proxiableUUID() returns that same custom slot with UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION() = "5.0.0" (OpenZeppelin Contracts v5 UUPSUpgradeable). The Gateway proxy carries its own AccessControl: hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x6c2404092cb1acfe9a06bc7de61bf619933edba5) = true and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x649b82c8de192e92f8dc9c88f63038016ce56310) = false.

controls.label: StandX BSC DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe (3-of-4)

sources.label: BSC public RPC (upgradeToAndCall authorization probe + hasRole reads, 2026-07-20)

controls.evidence: 2026-07-20: the previously unresolved 171-byte DEFAULT_ADMIN contract is a Gnosis Safe 1.1.1 proxy (masterCopy() = 0x29fcB43b46531BcA003ddC8FCB67FFE91900C762) with owners 0x222542fac5d6f5c2562312f907d202be807ee415, 0x955703b14f475bc0c53db9522283ba1bf1c8a8e1, 0x649b82c8de192e92f8dc9c88f63038016ce56310, and 0x56383a4af4482a708dbbac53bf03ad706028b203, threshold 3. The full role-event scan confirms DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE was granted to this Safe at block 48,266,832 and revoked from the deployer, with no later role events. 2026-07-20 follow-up: this same Safe is also the Gateway's terminal upgrade authority. A simulated eth_call of upgradeToAndCall(0xdf09ebf9a24080deedb0a9a85db0b3aa9a90caa1, "") against the Gateway proxy succeeds from this Safe and reverts from every other tested sender with the OpenZeppelin v5 error AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount(address,bytes32) (selector 0xe2517d3f) naming upgrade role 0x189ab7a9244df0848122154315af71fe140f3db0fe014031783b0946b8c9d2e3. Direct reads confirm hasRole(0x189ab7a9..., Safe) = true and hasRole(0x189ab7a9..., deployer EOA 0x649b82c8...) = false, and getRoleAdmin(0x189ab7a9...) = DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, which the Safe also holds.

review.evidence: StandX operates a two-layer model (on-chain Gateway + off-chain Settler/RSV multisig). Solana: at slot 425778638, DUSD mint DUSDt4AeLZHWYmcXnVGYdgAzjtzU5mXUVnTMdnSzAttM (Token-2022) has mintAuthority and freezeAuthority H4Mp7WL282pdbY9V9N7AJnsQwB5yyrU1E7svfsH2Ur5h, which is owned by StandX program STANDKqqZERMKosYH2PAtNtnt6mig4CRPycsRwjuVhB. StandX program has upgradeAuthority: None (immutable, programData 4XNF9sPKbX3SAor8mm8HDbWycw7qGC642NJs6mePqXQe at slot 425779135). Solana mint authority is a PDA of an immutable program. BSC: DUSD token 0xaf44a1e76f56ee12adbb7ba8acd3cbd474888122 has slot 0 = 0x2c02f575cdd0cc87de89ae6a493b05a5ed95065a (admin proxy pointing to implementation 0xdf09ebf9a24080deedb0a9a85db0b3aa9a90caa1); slot 1 of that proxy = 0x00b4f9b510893505acefb10ec91cbc972185088e (a second proxy pointing to 0xb69f4f80ec472ff9fe86933ac739329f8f72dc3b, a 31KB AccessControl+UUPS implementation). Partial role resolution on 2026-06-11 at BSC block 103642466: hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x6c2404092cb1acfe9a06bc7de61bf619933edba5) = true (a 171-byte unverified contract, structure unresolved) and hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x2c02f575…) = true (the Gateway controller proxy); hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x6c2404…) = false. 2026-07-20 follow-up resolved both open questions: the 171-byte DEFAULT_ADMIN contract is a Gnosis Safe 1.1.1 proxy (masterCopy 0x29fcB43b46531BcA003ddC8FCB67FFE91900C762) with 4 owners and threshold 3, and a complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked scan from deployment (block 47,000,000) through block 111,600,000 via bsc.lava.build found no role events after block 48,346,672 — MINTER_ROLE has only ever been held by the Gateway proxy 0x2c02f575cdd0cc87de89ae6a493b05a5ed95065a, and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE only by the Safe. 2026-07-20 (cur-9) resolved the BSC Gateway upgrade path: the Gateway is a UUPS (OZ v5) proxy reading implementation slot 0x827d913d90d0c987a6f064bb327aef37980afaf247de25f9b07747de0af89dd1, and upgradeToAndCall is gated by role 0x189ab7a9244df0848122154315af71fe140f3db0fe014031783b0946b8c9d2e3 held only by the 3-of-4 Safe 0x6c2404092cb1acfe9a06bc7de61bf619933edba5. The BSC mint surface is therefore fully enumerated and terminates at that Safe. 2026-07-27 (Kimi wave-7 re-review): the off-chain StandX Settler and RSV Fund backend still participates in the mint/redeem lifecycle with no published signer set or threshold; that component is issuer-undisclosed and not addressable on-chain, so it is recorded as an explicit issuer-backend control and the profile confidence is capped at manual-review rather than left unresolved.
